#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <tuple>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;
const double PI = 3.1415926535897932;

inline ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        ll temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);

#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif

    int test_cases = 1;
    for (int tc = 0; tc < test_cases; tc++) {
        double x, y, n;
        cin >> x >> y >> n;

        double ratio = x / y;
        ll best_num = 0, best_den = 0;
        double min_diff = 1e18;

        if (y <= n) {
            best_num = static_cast<ll>(x);
            best_den = static_cast<ll>(y);
        } else {
            for (ll denom = n; denom >= 1; denom--) {
                double approx = denom * ratio;
                ll numerator = static_cast<ll>(floor(approx + 0.5));

                double current_val = static_cast<double>(numerator) / denom;
                double diff = fabs(current_val - ratio);

                if (diff < min_diff || (diff == min_diff && numerator < best_num)) {
                    min_diff = diff;
                    best_num = numerator;
                    best_den = denom;
                }
            }
        }

        ll g = gcd(best_num, best_den);
        best_num /= g;
        best_den /= g;

        cout << best_num << "/" << best_den << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
